d.d: The use of a word or phrase to replace another one that is more offensive, blunt or vulgar.
A word or phrase that replaces another in this way.
A valved brass instrument with conical tubing similar in appearance to a tuba but of higher pitch.
Any plant of the genus Euphorbia, the spurges.
An excited state of joy; a feeling of intense happiness.
d.x: The runner was in (a state of) absolute euphoria after winning his first marathon.

d.d: Feeling great well-being or elation or intense happiness; characterized by euphoria.
d.x: In this moment, I am euphoric.

d.d: Productive of euphoria, causing great joy.
A drug that causes euphoria; a euphoriant.
